tests: authentication rejects malformed candidates and redacts malformed bridge credentials
client preference and locale are transmitted with exact PLAIN bytes
AMQPLAIN preserves embedded zero bytes and UTF-8 without PLAIN delimiters
selected async provider runs once and unselected providers are never evaluated
unsupported mechanism or locale does not call a secret provider or send credentials
provider rejection fails the handshake without writing an initial response
invalid or oversized provider results cannot escape through the bridge
handshake timeout aborts a pending provider and suppresses its late result
explicit AbortSignal cancels authentication before any late response can be sent
recovery retains original candidates and reselects against the new broker offer
custom provider refreshes once per selected recovery handshake
failed selected authentication is not silently retried with another mechanism
scope: Independent scripted TCP peer, including custom async response lifecycle and recovery; real certificate authentication is tested separately.
